D: Lightning heads to the World Grand Prix while Mater gets mistaken for a secret agent.
P: Serve dessert when Mater eats the wasabi in Tokyo thinking it's ice cream.
S: Edamame tossed warm in sesame oil, chilli flakes and sea salt
Edamame boiled in salted water for 4 minutes, drained and tossed while hot with sesame oil, chilli flakes and flaky salt, piled into small bowls.
Thin crêpes folded around ham and gruyere, crisped in the pan
Thin crêpe batter rested an hour, cooked in a buttered pan, filled with ham and gruyère, folded into quarters and crisped again, cut into triangles.
London chip shop chips with curry sauce
the final race through the streets of London

Thick-cut chips fried twice until crunchy, salted and served in paper cones with a mild chip shop curry sauce and malt vinegar. Cut 1kg washed potatoes into thick chips and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, drain and cool, then fry at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp and golden. For the sauce, soften 1 diced onion in 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp mild curry powder and 1 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 400ml chicken stock, 1 tbsp sultanas and 1 tsp honey. Simmer 10 minutes and blitz smooth. Salt the chips and serve with sauce and vinegar.
M: Prawns and cherry tomatoes with garlic, chilli and chicken stock
Garlic and chilli softened in olive oil, prawns and cherry tomatoes added with a splash of chicken stock until the prawns turn pink, tossed through spaghetti with parsley.
Luigi's Uncle Topolino in his little Italian village

Chicken thighs browned and simmered 45 minutes with tomato, olives, capsicum and rosemary until the sauce is thick, served with crusty bread. Season 8 chicken thigh pieces on the bone and brown in olive oil, skin side first, then set aside. Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced red capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in the pan. Add 2 rosemary sprigs, a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and 125ml chicken stock. Return the chicken, cover and simmer 45 minutes. Stir in 80g pitted kalamata olives for the last 10 minutes. Serve with a torn crusty loaf for the sauce.
W: Pistachio ice cream with crushed pistachios and honey
Pistachio ice cream scooped into chilled bowls, scattered with crushed roasted pistachios and drizzled with honey. Wasabi optional.
K: Blood orange and lemon juice with honey syrup over ice

Blood orange and lemon juice with a touch of honey syrup, topped with sparkling water over ice and garnished with orange and mint. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp warm water to make a quick syrup. Mix 400ml blood orange juice with the juice of 1 lemon and the honey syrup. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and a thin orange slice each. Pour in the juice mix to half full and top with 400ml cold sparkling water. Finish with a mint sprig and serve straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Best boiled and tossed just before serving; mix the sesame oil and chilli flakes up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Boil the edamame and drain.
Toss while hot with sesame oil, chilli flakes and sea salt.
Pile into small bowls.

dishes.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Rest the batter.
Melt the butter and cook thin crepes in a pan, brushing it with a little butter each time.
Fill each with ham and gruyere and fold into quarters.
Crisp again in the pan.
Cut into triangles and serve hot.

veg.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Rest the batter.
Fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter until golden, then stir in the spinach until wilted.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan.
Fill each with the mushrooms, spinach and cheese and fold into quarters.
Crisp again in the pan.
Cut into triangles and serve hot.

dishes.make_ahead: Peel the prawns and chop the parsley up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; cook the sauce and pasta on the night

steps.text: Peel the prawns, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Soften the garlic and chilli in the olive oil.
Add the prawns, tomatoes and stock and cook until the prawns turn pink.
Toss through the spaghetti with the parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; cook the sauce and pasta on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms into thick coins, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Sear the mushrooms in the olive oil until golden, then add the garlic and chilli.
Add the tomatoes and stock and cook until the tomatoes soften.
Toss through the spaghetti with the parsley.

dishes.make_ahead: Toast and crush the pistachios up to 3 days ahead and store airtight; scoop and serve on the night

steps.text: Toast the pistachios in a dry pan, then crush.
Scoop ice cream into chilled bowls.
Scatter with pistachios and drizzle with honey.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the honey syrup up to 3 days ahead and the juice mix up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; add ice and sparkling water to serve

steps.text: Stir the honey into the warm water to make a syrup.
Mix the blood orange juice, lemon juice and syrup.
Slice the orange thinly.
Fill wine glasses with ice and an orange slice each, pour in the juice mix to half full and top with sparkling water.
Finish with a mint sprig and serve straight away.

s.note: Edamame tossed warm in sesame oil, chilli flakes and sea salt
s.how: Boil 500g frozen edamame in salted water for 4 minutes and drain. Toss while hot with a teaspoon of sesame oil, a pinch of chilli flakes and sea salt flakes. Pile into small bowls for a fancy Tokyo party.

s.note: Thin crêpes folded around ham and gruyere, crisped in the pan
s.how: Whisk 150g flour, 2 eggs and 375ml milk and rest an hour. Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan. Fill each with ham and grated gruyere, fold into quarters and crisp again in the pan. Cut into triangles and serve hot.

m.note: Prawns and cherry tomatoes with garlic, chilli and a splash of stock
m.how: Soften crushed garlic and a pinch of chilli in olive oil. Add 400g green prawns and 250g halved cherry tomatoes and a splash of chicken stock. Cook until the prawns turn pink. Toss through 500g spaghetti with chopped parsley.

w.note: Pistachio ice cream with crushed pistachios and honey
w.how: Scoop pistachio ice cream into chilled bowls. Scatter with crushed roasted pistachios and drizzle with a little honey. Serve straight away. Do not mistake the wasabi for it, as one tow truck learned the hard way.

d.note: Blood orange and lemon juice with honey syrup over ice
d.how: Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp warm water to make a quick syrup. Mix 400ml blood orange juice with the juice of 1 lemon and the honey syrup. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and a thin orange slice each. Pour in the juice mix to half full and top with 400ml cold sparkling water. Finish with a mint sprig and serve straight away.
